name: Toi Ly Son
summary: Tỏi Lý Sơn is the island’s garlic: small bulbs with even cloves and smooth white skin. It smells strong but its heat is mild, and it is also sold as single-clove garlic, black garlic, garlic wine, and garlic in honey.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the smell is strong and the heat is mild, not harsh.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines treats the bulb as a gift, and also names tỏi cô đơn, tỏi đen, rượu tỏi, and tỏi ngâm mật ong.
The young plant is the gỏi tỏi, which is a separate plate.
seoDescription: Lý Sơn garlic, small bulbs with a strong smell and a mild heat, also sold black, single-clove, and in honey. 150,000–190,000 VND a kilogram.
